caption: The drawing depicts a beaded handbag with a silver or metallic-looking curved top frame and a handle consisting of a chain of blue or gray beads. The main body of the handbag features a beaded floral pattern, with five-petal flowers in shades of purple, red, and blue, each with yellow or orange centers, interspersed with green leaves. The floral patterns are arranged densely, covering most of the bag’s surface. Below the floral section, there are wavy red lines and additional green leaf shapes near the bottom. The handbag terminates in a fringe of straight strands made of blue or gray beads, hanging down from the lower edge. The background is plain and off-white. In the bottom right corner, the name “Ruth Buker” is written in blue.
title: Purse
